tax.text: He proposed a tax on the super-rich to help end homelessness.
tax.quote: And by adding a small tax on the super-rich—the top 0.1%—we can help end homelessness for good.

wages.text: He said fair laws should raise wages and treat workers fairly.
wages.quote: We need fair laws that raise wages, make sure everyone gets equal pay for equal work, and treat all workers fairly.

guns.text: His campaign says he supports preserving Second Amendment rights while pursuing gun-policy reform.
guns.quote: I am committed to preserving our 2nd Amendment rights while fighting for common sense reform.

abortion.text: His campaign includes bodily autonomy in its equal-rights platform.
abortion.quote: That means fair pay, equal rights, bodily autonomy, and protecting people from hate, while still respecting free speech.

health.text: His campaign supports expanding Medicare and moving toward health care for everyone.
health.quote: We can fix this by expanding Medicare and moving toward healthcare for everyone. That means lower costs, better care, and fewer people falling through the cracks.

energy.text: He supports investing in a clean-energy future and protecting natural resources.
energy.quote: We need to invest in a clean energy future that uses multiple sources to stay safe and strong.
